snippet.title: ROBOT RHAPSODY - Early Teaser
snippet.description:
A retro-styled, pixel art RPG now in production!
This video represents early footage of the game.
KICKSTARTER Coming early 2026!

Be sure to follow us and click the link to be notified as soon as our campaign goes live!
LINK: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1054472336/robot-rhapsody

Wishlist Robot Rhapsody on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3758170/Robot_Rhapsody/

Join our Discord Server: discord.gg/Y4rKwzQk7T
Follow us on X: https://x.com/BelovedRapture
Follow us on Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/rapturousgames.bsky.social

------------
Robot Rhapsody is a 'retro inspired' indie RPG, set in a near-future world on the edges of machine singularity and mass anarchy.

👾 Pixel art presentation, & PlayStation 1-inspired soundtrack.
❤️‍🔥 Strategic and challenging turn-based combat.
⚙️ HACK robot enemies to join the party. UPGRADE them all with distinct items and parts.
💥 Evocative character-driven stories, with cyberpunk-inspired hemes touching AI worship, 'futurism'/ techno cults, dystopias, and transcendence.
🗺️ Open-ended exploration and questing, but with a linear main story.

---
2025 Trailer credits:
Director: Aaron T. Crawford
Pixel Art: Fabian Hosung
Character Portraits: Robb Eddy
Soundtrack:  Andreas Kotsamanidis
Battle Animations: Joseph Seraph
